/de nas me tog gi tshom bu dkyil 'khor du dgod par bya ste/ dbus su oṃ āḥhūm̐ na maḥzhes brjod de me tog dor ro/ /shar du/ gaṃ gau rī na maḥ zhes bya bas me tog dor ro/ /lhor/ tsaṃ tsau rī na maḥ zhes bya bas me tog dor ro/ /nub tu/ baṃ bai ta lī na maḥ zhes bya bas dor ro/ /byang du/ ghaṃ ghasma rī na maḥ zhes bya bas dor ro/ /dbang ldan du/ paṃ puk+ka sī na maḥ zhes bya bas dor ro/ /me'i mtshams su/ saṃ sa wa rī na maḥ zhes bya bas dor ro/ bden bral du/ laṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī na maḥ zhes bya bas so/ /rlung mtshams su/ ḍaṃ ḍom+bi ni na maḥ zhes pas so/ /de dag ni me tog gi tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas bdag nyid kyi snying ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shangs bug g.yon pa nas zhugs te/ thugs ka'i pad+ma la bsnun pa tsam gyis thugs bskul nas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du sprul te mdun gyi nam mkha' la byon par bsams la/ de'i 'od zer gyi sna la 'jus te 'ongs pa'i bgegs thams cad tshar gcad pa'i bsam pas/ hūm̐ bzhis bgegs bskrad par bya'o/ /de nas/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+sha ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bai ta lī ban+dha ya baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī ba shiṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi lha dgu me tog gi tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang dbang du bya ba ste/ yi ge brgya pas kyang brtan par bya'o/ /de nas phyag bya ste/ gti mug gis mnan 'gro bltas te/ /'gro ba gti mug zhi bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje can gyis gau rī mdzad/ /de bas gau rī bstod phyag 'tshal/ /zhe sdang gis mnan 'gro bltas nas/ /'gro ba zhe sdang zhi bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje can gyi tsau rīr mdzad/ /de bas tsau rī bstod phyag 'tshal/ /nga rgyal gyis mnan 'gro bltas nas/

/'gro ba nga rgyal zhi bya'i phyir/ /gtso bos bai ta lī gzugs mdzad/ /de bas bai ta bstod phyag 'tshal/ /'dod chags kyis dkrugs 'gro bltas nas/ /'gro ba 'dod chags zhi bya'i phyir/ /gtso bos ghasma rī gzugs mdzad/ /de bas ghasma rī bstod 'dud/ /bdag med ma dang gnyis med gzugs/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum bdag /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal/ /de nas yang / oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bcom ldan 'das la mchod la/ oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aḥzhes bya bas bcom ldan 'das ma la mchod do/ /yang / oṃ aṣ+ṭā na nā ya na maḥ oṃ piṅgar+dho ke sha wartam ne na maḥ oṃ tsa turbiṃ sha ti ne trā ya na maḥ oṃ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya na maḥ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe na maḥ oṃ ka pā la mā lā dha ri ṇe na maḥ oṃ ādh+ma ta kū ra tsit+t+rā ya na maḥ oṃ/ ar+dhen+du daṃṣ+ṭi ne na maḥ zhes bya ba rkang pa brgyad kyis mchod do/ /de nas nang dang phyi dang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas kyang yang dag par mchod de/ phyi rol gyi bya ba'i mchod pas kyang mchod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bzlas pa'i me tog dang mchod rdzas thams cad la bsnun pas/ byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sar+b+ba saṃ sho dha ne hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bya bas dri chab kyis bsangs te/ oṃ badz+ra ni ri ti hūm̐ zhes bya bas zhabs bsil phul la/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dhar+m+māḥsar+b+ba pā paṃ ni saṃ sho dha ya/ sar+b+ba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes bya bas zhal bsil phul/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ/ zhes bya bas ar+ghaṃ phul/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe ā hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhām̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai bi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa gha ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya bas go rim bzhin du/ me tog dang / spos dang / mar me dang / lho bshos dang / sil snyan rnams dbul bar bya'o/

/gzhan yang dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang bcas pa rnams la bdag dbul bar bgyi lags kyis/ thugs rje chen pos bzhes su gsol/ de nas bstod pa nyi shu pas kyang bstod la/ de nas sdig pa bshags par bya ste/ ji srid 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i 'khor bar phyin ci log gi rtog pas bsags pa'i sdig pa'i las bdag gis bgyis pa dang / bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bshags shing / phyis sdom par bgyid do/ /sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed pa 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / so so'i skye bo thams cad kyi bsod nams la rjes su yi rang bar bgyid do/ /bdag byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i khams gsum bde ba chen por rnam par ro gcig pa'i sangs rgyas dgyes mdzad rdo rje dang / des gsungs pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya theg pa chen po'i chos ma lus pa dang dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i chos dang / byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun dang de'i 'khor lo la 'khor bar gnas pa'i lha mo'i tshogs la bdag skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba sgrub pa dang / 'di dag ji srid mthar thug pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la dgod pa'i phyir bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la yi rang ste/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /zhes sems bskyed la/ de nas bla na med pa'i theg pa chen po'i lam nyid la brten par bya'o/ /bdag nyid kyang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la lus 'bul lags kyis/

thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis bzhes su gsol/ zhes lus phul te/ de nas smon lam gdab par bya ba ni/ rigs skyes rjes su ma nyams shing / /dam tshig can dgyes rdo rje 'chang / /snying rjer ldan zhing bla mar gus/ /skye zhing skye bar bdag gyur cig /lag na rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni 'don pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can/ /skye zhing skye bar bdag gyur cig /he ru ka dpal bdag gyur nas/ /sems can rnams kyi don yang byed/ /he ru ka yi go 'phang mchog thob nas/ /sems can ma lus 'di la 'jog par shog /de ltar bstod pa'i mchod sbyin las ni rdo rje rigs mchog tu ni bdag myur skye gyur cig /sems can phan phyir yang dag thabs kyi yon tan dang ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs bzhin bdag gyur cig /rnal 'byor ma kun la ni dpe med bde ster rdo rje sems dpa' bzhin du bdag gyur cig /phyag rgya drug gis bdag brgyan dur khrod gnas su tshangs par spyod dang ldan par bdag gyur cig /de'i 'og tu yi ge brgya pas cho ga kha bskang zhing bshags pa bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ driḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ sar+b+ba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sar+b+ba kar+m+ma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñja badz+rī bha ba ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes pas bshags la/ ye shes kyi lha/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ zhes bya bas gshegs su gsol lo/ /dam tshig pa bdag gi thugs kar bsdus la/ me tog gi tshom bu dbus su bsdus nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ bzlas la gzhag go /zhes bya ba gsungs te/ don ni go bar zad cing / 'dis ni me tog gi tshom bu'i maṇ+ḍal du lha mchod pa kun mtshon par nus la/ me tog gi tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor ro zhes gsungs pa 'dis ni/

mngon par brjod pa bla ma'i rgyud du/ dkyil 'khor drug gsungs pa'i/ lnga pa me tog dgod pa ste/ zhes pa ste/ dkyil 'khor 'di lta bu la dgongs zhes snga rabs rnams gsungs pa/ dgongs pa la gnas pa gsal bar byas pa'ang yin no/ /gsum pa bgrang phreng bcang ba'i cho ga ni/ gsungs pa/ a sogs ka sogs yang dag ldan/ /yi ge brgyad ni brgyad lhag pa/ /bgrang phreng du ni rab brjod bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yis sngags bzlas pa'o/ /gsal byed sum cu drug thung ba'i/ /bco brgyad dbyangs rnams dang ldan pa/ /brgyad lhag brgya yi phyed rnams kyis/ /bgrang phreng du ni der brjod bya/ /rgyu skar rkang pa'i dbye ba yis/ /gsum par yongs su brjod par bya/ /rgyu skar phyed kyi cha yis ni/ /bzhi pa de nyid gang phyir yin/ /sum cu drug gi dbyangs dbye bas/ /lnga par yongs su brjod par bya/ /rgyu skar longs spyod dbye ba yis/ /drug par yongs su brjod par bya/ /bco brgyad dbyangs kyi dbye ba yis/ /bdun par yongs su brjod par bya/ /slar yang sum cu rtsa drug gi /gsal byed dbye bas brgyad pa'o/ /dka' thub tsam gyi bgrang phreng gis/ /'di ltar rnam pa brgyad du bshad/ /shel gyi bco brgyad rnams kyis gcig /brtul zhugs can gyis zhi bar byed/ /mu tig sum cu drug dbyangs su/ /brjod pas mi rnams rgyas pa'o/ /nyi shu rtsa bdun rgyu skar gyi/ /mi sos gsod la bshad pa'o/ /de yi nyis 'gyur bong bu'i sos/ /sdang bar byed dang skrod la'ang 'gyur/ /gsal byed sum cu drug dag pas/ /dbang du bya sogs bo de tses/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed yongs bsres pa/ /bzhi lhag pa yi lnga bcu yis/ /pad ma zhes pa'am yang na ni/ /tsan+dan sa bon gyis dgug pa'o/ /rgyu skar phyed kyi rkang pa yis/ /rmongs par byed la lung tang bshad/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed rkang pa dag /rengs la ru rag sha ru bshad/ /de ltar dag pa'i las la ni/

/dag pa rnam pa brgyad du bshad/ /'dres pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /sa bon nam 'dir nor bus bya/ /khams kyi kha dog dbye ba yis/ /ji ltar rnyed pa de bzhin byos/ /zhes te/ 'di bshad pa la gnyis/ rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang / gzhung gi tshig don dgrol ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bgrang phreng gi rnam par gzhag pa la/ rgyud sde gzhan gyi bshad pa nas 'byung ba 'dir smos na ni yi ge mang bar 'gyur bas/ sems 'grel phyogs nas 'byung ba tsam smos pa la ni/ grangs kyi rnam pa dang / rgyu'i dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po la/ las kyi dbye bas mang nyung gi rnam pa so sor phye ba ni gzhung gi tshig don gyis 'di nyid du gsal bar 'gyur la/ mang ba'i phyogs ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo las bgrang phreng rab gnas kyi skabs su/ bgrang phreng la/ yang hūm̐ gi yi ge nor bu yongs su bgrang ba rnams ni mtshan dang dpe byad rnams/ zhes nor bu'i grangs sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad brgyad cu ste brgya rtsa bcu gnyis gsungs pa lta bu ste/ 'di la ni las so so'i dbye ba mi bzhed pa'o/ /yang 'grel chen du/ brgya rtsa bcu gnyis po de rnams las/ sku dang gsung dang thugs dang ye shes kyi gnas rnams spangs nas/ lhag ma brgyad rtsa brgyad po rnams bgrang phreng la ste/ lhun po la zhal bzhi'o/ /zhes mtshan dpe dag pa'i nor bu brgyad dang bcu gnyis las/ sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje bzhi spyi khyab yin zhing / lhun po'i zhal bzhi dag pas mdo 'dzin bzhi brtsegs dang / lhag ma phreng rdog brgyad rtsa brgyad du gsungs pa ni/ 'chad par 'gyur ba/ rengs pa la ru rāk+ṣa'i phreng ba'i grangs bshad pa dang mthun no/ /rgyu'i dbye ba ni/ mang ba'i phyogs la/ phyag rdor bstod 'grel du/ mi dang / rnga mo dang / bong bu'i rus pa gsum/ pad+ma dang / tsan+dan dmar po dang / lung tang dmar po gsum/ bo de tse dang / ru rāk+ṣa dang / khra'i phreng ba gsum/ shel dang /

mu tig dang / dung gsum ste bcu gnyis su bshad la/ brgyad du gsungs pa ni/ dus 'khor dbang le las/ shel dang mu tig dang ni mi dang bong bu'i so'am rus pa dag dang bo de tse dang ni/ /pad ma zhes bya dbang mig lung tang bde gshegs rigs kyi dbang gis sngags bzlas pa la phreng bar 'gyur/ /zhes te/ zhi ba la shel/ rgyas pa la mu tig bsad pa la mi'i so/ /bskrad pa la bong bu'i so'am rus pa/ dbang la bo de tse/ dgug pa la pad+ma'am tsan+dan dmar po/ rengs pa la dbang mi gaste ru drāk+ṣa/ rmongs pa la lung tang gi bgrang phreng steng brgyad gsungs la/ dgyes rdor nyung ngu'i rgyud 'di nyid du ni/ shel gyis rengs par bzlas pa nyid/ /dbang la tsan+dan dmar po nyid/ /lung tang gis ni mngon spyod nyid/ /ni rang shus ni sdang ba la/ /rta yi rus pas skrod pa nyid/ /bram ze'i rus pas dgug pa nyid/ /glang po'i rus pa'i char dbab pa/ /ma he yis kyang bsad pa la'o/ /zhes brgyad gsungs shing / 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gzhung 'bum phrag lnga pa las brgyad gsungs pa ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo ji lta ba nyid du gsal bas shes par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ nor bu'i grangs kyi rnam pa brgyad du bshad pa dang / de nyid las kyi dbye ba brgyad dang sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'dir bgrang phreng gi nor bu'i grangs kyi dbye ba ni rnam pa brgyad de/ brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang /1 de'i phyed lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa dang /2 nyer bdun pa dang /3 yang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa dang /4 sum cu rtsa drug pa dang /5 yang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa dang /6 rtsa brgyad pa dang /7 yang sum cu rtsa drug pa'o/8 /brgyad po de dag kyang rnam par dag pa'i grangs mi mtshungs pa dang / phreng ba'i rgyu mi 'dra ba'i dbye bas phye ba ste/ de la dang po brgyad rtsa brgyad pa ni sngar bshad pa gsal byed so drug thung ring gis phye ba bdun cu rtsa gnyis la/ dbyangs bco brgyad thung ring gi sum cu rtsa drug bsnan pa'i a sogs ka sogs brgyad lhag pa'i brgya rnam par dag pa ste ru rāk+ṣa'i phreng ba'i grangs so/

/gnyis pa lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa ni/ gsal byed so drug dbyangs thung ngu bco brgyad dang bcas pa dag pa ste/ pad+ma'am/ tsan+dan gyi phreng ba'i grangs so/ /gsum pa nyer bdun pa ni/ rgyu skar gyi grangs dag pa ste mi so'i phreng ba'i grangs so/ /bzhi pa lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa ni/ rgyu skar rnams kyi rkang pa'i phyed kyi cha rnam par dag pa ste rgyu skar nyer bdun gyi rkang pa bzhi bzhi bsdoms pa ni brgya rtsa brgyad yin la/ de'i phyed ni lnga bcu rtsa bzhi yin pas so/ /de ni lung tang gi phreng ba'i grangs so/ /lnga pa sum cu rtsa drug pa ni/ dbyangs so drug dag pa ste mu tig gi phreng ba'i grangs so/ /drug pa lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa ni/ rgyu skar gyi longs spyod zer yang / 'gyur rnying du/ skar ma cha shas dbye ba yis/ /zhes pa/ skar ma nyer bdun cha shas gnyis su phye bas lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa zhes bya ste/ 'og tu/ nyer bdun pa mi so'i grangs su bshad pa'i rjes su de'i nyis 'gyur bong bu'i sos/ zhes pa'i don te/ 'dir nyer bdun gyi grangs byas na bong bu'i so'i grangs ston byed 'di grangs ston pa'i skabs 'dir chad par 'gyur ba de ltar mi bya'o/ /bdun pa bco brgyad pa ni/ dbyangs bco brgyad kyi dbye ba ste shel gyi phreng ba'i grangs so/ /brgyad pa sum cu rtsa drug pa ni/ gsal byed so drug dag pa ste bo de tse'i phreng ba'i grangs so/ /de ltar grangs kyi dbye ba rnam pa brgyad du bshad pa de dag ni/ dka' thub can zhes pa/ sngags kyi sdom brtson rnams kyi phreng ba'i grangs so/ /gnyis pa de nyid las kyi dbye ba dang sbyar ba ni/ shel gyi bco brgyad rnams kyis gcig /brtul zhugs can gyis zhi bar byed/ /ces pa nas/ de ltar dag pa'i las la ni/ /dag pa rnam pa brgyad du bshad/ /ces pa'i bar te/ phreng ba'i grangs dang rgyu'i dbye ba brgyad pa de dag las kyi dbye ba brgyad dang sbyor ba ste/

zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / gsod pa dang / sdang bar byed pa sogs dang / dbang du bya ba sogs dang / dgug pa dang / rmongs par byed pa dang / rengs par bya ba ste/ brgyad dang sbyar bas rtogs par sla'o/ /brgyad po de pas/ dag pa zhes bya ba 'ba' zhig pa ste/ las gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ 'dres pa zhi rgyas thun mong gi las lta bu la ni/ sngags kyi sa bon nam/ nor bu'i grangs sam/ khams kyi kha dog gi dbye ba ji ltar rigs pa rnams bsres la rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i las la byos shig ces man ngag tu gdams pa'o/ /bzhi pa bzlas pa'i bya ba ci 'dra bas 'grub pa'i nges pa la/ bshad par dam bca' ba dang / nges pa bshad pa dngos gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ gsungs pa/ de nas 'di la rnal 'byor pa'i/ /gang gis myur du 'grub byed 'gyur/ /rigs las skyes par gyur pa dang / /sngags kyi mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /zhes te/ khams gang gi rigs las byung ba'i sngags zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa la drug ste/ phyi nang khams kyi nges pa dbye ba/ nges pa'i dbang gis las rnams byed tshul/ khams la brten pa'i dgra grogs brtsi ba/ /brtsis pa'i bzlas pa las rnams 'grub tshul/ man ngag tshang bas 'grub pa'i nges pa/ man ngag spangs pas 'grub pa med tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ yi ge'i sgo nas rigs kyi 'jog tshul/ sum cu rtsa bdun rigs kyi nges pa'o/ /dang po la lnga ste/ yi ge'i khams dang / 'byung khungs 'jog tshul/ khams drug ldan pas bsgrub pa'i nges pa/ gnas la brten nas yi ge'i 'byung tshul/ sa bon dang khams kyi kha dog dbye ba/ yi ge so so'i khams kyi rnam gzhag go /dang po ni/ gsungs pa/ a ku ha thaka mgrin byung gang / /dbyangs dang gsal byed mtshan nyid rnams/ /nam mkha'i khams las yang dag byung / /de rnams ha yig kyis shes byed/ /i tsu ya sha rkan las byung / /dbyangs dang gsal byed mtshan nyid rnams/ /rlung gi khams las yang dag byung /

/de rnams ya yig kyis shes byed/ /ṛ ṭu ra ṣa spyi bo las/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed mtshan nyid rnams/ /me yi khams las yang dag byung / /ra yig yi ges shes par byed/ /u pu wa nyapa chur gyur gang / /dbyangs dang gsal byed mtshan nyid rnams/ /chu yi khams las yang dag byung / /de rnams wa yig gis shes byed/ /li tu la sa so las skyes/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed mtshan nyid rnams/ /sa yi khams las yang dag byung / /de rnams ma yig gis shes byed/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed spangs pa yi/ /rjes su nga ro rnam bcad kyang / /ye shes khams las yang dag byung / /de ltar rigs kyi khams drug po/ /zhes te/ phal cher ni/ sngar grong khyer bskyod pa'i sngags kyi nges don skabs kyi bshad pas go bar zad la/ 'dir/ ha yig gis shes par byed do zhes sogs ni/ de rnams stong pa nam mkha'i khams las byung bar ni ha yig gis mtshon nas shes par bya'o/ /zhes sogs sbyar nas/ yi ge rnams la rigs kyi khams drug dbye ba'i tshul ni de lta bu'o/ /de yang / ya ṇa lnga'i khams ni rim pa bzhin nam mkha' rlung me chu sa zhes yongs su grags pa'i phyir/ de dang 'byung khungs mthun pa rnams kyang de'i khams las byung ba dang / lhag ma nga ro rnam bcad ni ye shes las byung bar shugs kyis grub ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsungs pa/ sa dang chu dang sreg za rlung / /khu ba dang ni rdul gyi rigs/ /khams drug ldan par 'dir brjod de/ /skyes bu gang zag chen po 'o/ /gtso bo a sogs ka sogs bdag /mnga' bdag sngags kun bskyed mdzad pa'o/ /phung po khams kyi sngags bdag nyid/ /so sor bsdus pa bde byed kyis/ /sgra sgrub pa yi don du bstan/ /sngags grub pa la'ang de kho na/ /thams cad mkhyen pas de nyid bsngags/ /byis pa klog pa'i rim pas min/ /zhes te/ gang zag chen po'o zhes pa yan gyis ni/ sngags sgrub pa'i rten du khams drug ldan gyi skyes bu bsngags par bstan la/

de man gyis ni/ skyes bu des sgrub pa'i sngags la a sogs ka sogs kyi rim pa yang phung po drug dang khams drug gi dbye bas sde tshan du bsdus pa/ bde byed kyis sgra sgrub pa'i don gyi yi ge bsdu ba las ji ltar bstan pa de dang 'dra bar/ thams cad mkhyen pas sngags sgrub pa'i yi ge bsdu ba'i tshul yang rim pa de kho na bsngags kyi/ byis pa klog pa'i rim pas ni ma yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ gsungs pa/ mgrin pa rkan dang mgrin pa mchu/ /'dres pa gsal byed dbyangs rnams gang / /gnas gnyis pa dang gzhan pa rnams/ /rang bzhin dag pa'o gnyis skyes min/ /mgrin pa la sogs gnas gcig tu/ /rang bzhin dag pa las skyes dbyangs/ /rtag tu brjod par bya ba'i sngags/ /de ni gnas gnyis brjod pa min/ /a yig dbyangs dang ldan pa yis/ /gang zhig rang gi gnas mi 'dor/ /de ni rang bzhin gyis dag pa'o/ /gsal byed rnam bcad thig le can/ /e yig la sogs dbyangs ldan pas/ /gnas gnyis pa ru gang 'jug pa/ /rang bzhin dag pa zhes de min/ /gsal byed nyis 'gyur du 'gyur ro/ /zhes te/ 'dir yi ge la/ 'byung sa'i gnas la brten nas/ rang bzhin dag pa ba dang / gnas gnyis 'dres ma zhes bya ba gnyis las/ dang po ni mgrin pa la sogs pa'i gnas gcig tu skyes pa a zhes pa dang ka zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni mgrin pa dang rkan gyi gnas gnyis 'dres pa ki zhes pa lta bu dang / mgrin pa dang mchu'i gnas gnyis 'dres pa ku zhes pa lta bu dang / gzhan yang / rnam bcad dang thig le can gyi dbyangs gsal rnams lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ gsungs pa/ dbang chen dkyil 'khor ser po ste/ /la yi yi ge las byung ba'o/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor dkar po ste/ /wa yi yi ge las byung ba'o/ /me yi dkyil 'khor dmar po ste/ /re ba'i yi ge las byung ba'o/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po ste/ /ya yi yi ge las byung ba'o/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ljang gu ste/

/yi ge ha las byung ba 'o/ /rnam bcad thig le las byung ba/ /ye shes kha dog kun la skyes/ /de bzhin ta sde li yig gi /yi ge las skyes ser po ste/ /pa sde la sogs u yig gi /dbyangs las byung ba dkar por bshad/ /ṭa sde las byung ṛ yig gi /dbyangs las byung ba dmar po'o/ /tsa sde las skyes i yig gi /dbyangs las byung ba nag por bshad/ /ka sde las skyes a yig gi /dbyangs las byung ba ljang gur bshad/ /de bzhin sa yig las byung dang / /al yig las byung ser po'o/ /dkar po kapa yig las byung dang / /e yig yon tan las byung ba'o/ /dmar po ṣa yig las byung dang / /ar yig yon tan las byung ba'o/ /nag po sha yig las byung dang / /e yig yon tan las byung ba'o/ /ljang gu thaka yig las byung dang / /a yig yon tan las byung ba'o/ /zhes te/ yi ge so so'i khams kyi dbye bas so so'i kha dog rnam par dbye ba ste/ dus 'khor du/ sna tshogs gnag dmar ri bong can dang gser 'dra phung po khams kyi lhag pa'i lha dang ldan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /lnga pa ni/ gtso bo'i khams kyi rnam gzhag dang / rang bzhin zhes pa phal pa'i khams kyi rnam gzhag gnyis kyis shes par bya dgos pa yang / gsungs pa/ a i ṛ u l̥ zhes 'di/ /dag pa rang bzhin las skyes dbyangs/ /a e ar o al zhes 'di/ /yon tan rang bzhin gnyis las skyes/ /ha ya ra wa la zhes 'di/ /yaṇa du bsgyur ba de bzhin gnyis/ /phal pa gtso bos gnyis dbus su/ /gtso bo dkyil 'khor 'dren pa'o/ /slar yang sde pa so so la/ /rang bzhin rnam pa lnga ru bshad/ /nga nya ṇa na ma zhes 'di/ /stong pa'i khams las byung rnams so/ /gha dzha ḍha dha bha 'di rnams/ /rlung gi khams las yang dag byung / /ga dza ḍa da ba 'di rnams/ /me yi khams las yang dag byung / /kha tsha ṭha tha pha zhes 'di/ /chu yi khams las byung ba rnams/ /ka tsa ṭa ta pa 'di rnams/ /sa yi khams las byung ba rnams/

/rigs drug yi ge'i dbye ba yis/ /rang bzhin gtso bo'i dbye ba las/ /yi ge so so'i dbye ba yis/ /rigs ni rnam pa lnga ru 'gyur/ /zhes te go bar zad do/ /gnyis pa rigs sum cu rtsa bdun gyi nges pa ni/ gsungs pa/ ji ltar sa dang mjug ma ser/ /de ltar mjug dang lus dbang po/ /chu dang zla ba ji ltar dkar/ /de ltar 'du shes lce dbang po/ /me dang nyi ma ji ltar dmar/ /tsho ba mig ste de dag kyang / /rlung dang sgra gcan ji ltar gnag /de ltar 'du byed dang ni sna'o/ /ji ltar nam mkha' rgyu ba ljang / /rnam shes rna ba de ltar ro/ /ye shes ri byi ji ltar sngo/ /de ltar ye shes yid bshad do/ /de bzhin dri dang gzugs dag dang / /ro dang reg bya kho na dang / /sgra dang chos kyi dbyings kyang ste/ /khams drug rigs te rim pa las/ /de bzhin bshang lam rkang pa dang / /lag pa ngag gi dbang de bzhin/ /bha ga mchog gi dbang po yang / /sa la sogs pa'i rigs las byung / /de bzhin brjod dang len pa dang / /'gro dang bshang gci 'dzag nyid dang / /khu ba 'pho ba'i bya ba ste/ /'di rnams sa sogs rigs las byung / /de ltar khams drug brjod pa dang / /phung po drug dang dbang po drug /yul dang las kyi dbang po rnams/ /las kyi dbang po'i bya ba drug /phung po drug dang khams dbye bas/ /khams rnams sum cu rtsa drug rnams/ /sum cu bdun pa shes rab ste/ /chos kun stong pa nyid gcig pa'o/ /zhes te/ de yang / khams drug dang / phung po drug dang / dbang po drug dang / yul drug dang / las kyi dbang po drug dang / las kyi dbang po'i bya ba drug ste/ khams sum cu rtsa drug po rnams phyi dang nang gi dbye bas gnas pa la/ khams drug gis phye ba'i sa bon las lha so so'i rigs dang / mdog dang / sngags kyi dbye ba shes pas sum cu rtsa drug tu rnam par gzhag pa dang / /rtsa bdun pa chos thams cad 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gcig pa khyab byed kyi ngo bos gnas pa ste/

sngar maṇ+ḍal gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa nges pa'i dbang gis las rnams byed tshul la/ phye ste bshad pa dang / bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /dang po la'ang gnyis te/ bzlas pa'i khams las rnams byed tshul dang / ye shes kyi nges pas las rnams byed tshul lo/ /dang po la/ dag pa'i las dang / 'dres ma'i las gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ gsungs pa/ khams rnams phyi dang lus la yang / /ji ltar lus la de bzhin gzhan/ /dag pa'i sa yis rengs pa yin/ /dag pa'i chu yis zhi ba'o/ /dag pa'i rlung gis sdang bar byed/ /dag pa'i stong pas 'tsho ba dang / /ye shes dag pas gsod pa ste/ /dag pa'i las rnams drug ces pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de la ta yig ni dag pa'i sa zhes bya ste/ ta sde ni sa yin la/ de'i nang nas kyang sa yin pas sa 'ba' zhig pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du/ pha yig dag pa'i chu yin pa sogs 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rnam par bsres pas gzhan rnams te/ /sa dang chu ni bsres pa yis/ /lus can kun gyi rgyas pa'o/ /rlung dang me ni rnam bsres pas/ /lus can thams cad 'gug pa'o/ /rlung dang chu ni rnam bsres pas/ /mi rnams kyi ni bskyod par 'gyur/ /sa dang stong pa bsres pa yis/ /lus can rnams kyi ltung bar 'gyur/ /sa dang ye shes bsres pa yis/ /ltung ba slar yang slong bar byed/ /chu dang me ni bsres pa yis/ /skyes pa bud med 'ju bar byed/ /sa dang rlung du bsres pa yis/ /rmongs dang phur bus 'debs par 'gyur/ /stong pa dang ni chu bsres pas/ /sems can rnams ni rta bar 'gyur/ /stong pa ye shes bsres pa yis/ /phyir yang 'tsho ba nyid yin no/ /me dang sa ni bsres pa yis/ /lus can thams cad gdung bar byed/ /me dang stong pa bsres pa yis/ /lus can rnams la rims su 'gyur/ /me dang ye shes bsres pa yis/ /lus can rnams la 'khrug par 'gyur/ /sna tshogs nges par skrod par byed/ /rlung dang ye shes bsres pa yis/

/skad cig gis ni khams gsum 'ching / /stong pa ye shes bsres pa yis/ /lus can thams cad bskyed pa'o/ /zhes te/ de yang / tha yig ni sa dang chu bsres pa zhes bya ste/ ta sde sa yin la/ de'i nang nas chu'i khams yin pa'i phyir/ dza yig ni rlung dang me bsres pa ste/ tsa sde+e rlung yin la/ de'i nang tshan gyi me'i khams yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du/ tsha yig rlung dang chu bsres pa yin pa sogs kun la 'gre zhing / de lta bu'i yi ge rnams kyi las so so 'grub ces bya'o/ /las sgrub pa de dag ni/ ji ltar lus la de bzhin gzhan/ /zhes pa las/ gzhan yin la/ lus kyi dbang du byas na ni/ sa dang chu bsres pas lus can kun gyi lus rgyas par byed/ ces sogs sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa ye shes kyi nges pas las rnams byed tshul ni/ rlung sems dbu mar sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor pas de lta bu'i bzlas pa la mi ltos par yang las rnams 'grub bo zhes pa la dgongs te gsungs pa/ ye shes gcig pus las rnams kun/ /ye shes smra ba rnams kyis byed/ /bzlas brjod med cing bgrang phreng med/ /sbyin sreg sngags dang mchod pa med/ /las rnams thams cad rnal 'byor pas/ /bsam gtan tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa bsdus te bstan pa ni/ de ltar sngags gang rigs gsum dang / /bzhi dang lnga yi rigs rnams kyang / /khams rnams kyi ni rang bzhin las/ /cho ga mtha' yas las rnams byed/ /ces pa de ltar rigs drug sngags/ /dag pa dang ni phan tshun 'dres/ /de rnams grangs med sems can gyis/ /lha yi dngos grub sgrub pa'o/ /zhes te/ ji skad bshad pa de ltar yi ge rnams la khams drug gam rigs drug tu phye nas/ dag pa dang 'dres ma gnyis su bsdus pa 'di las ni/ sngags gang zhig sku gsung thugs kyi rigs gsum dang / rdo rje bzhi'i rigs dang / sangs rgyas lnga'i 'am yum lnga'i rigs su phye ba rnams kyi las kyi cho ga mtha' yas pa rnams kyang drug po 'di dag gi nges pas las rnams byed cing /

dngos grub rnams sgrub pa'o zhes bya bar dgongs so/ /gsum pa khams la brten pa'i dgra grogs brtsi ba la bshad par dam bca' ni/ lha yi dngos grub sgrub pa la/ khams lnga yi ni rang bzhin las/ /sngags kyi mtshan nyid brjod par bya/ /dgra dang bshes dang btang snyoms pa/ /sems can don phyir brjod pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de nas bshad pa dngos la gnyis te/ yi ge'i khams dang dgra grogs brtsi tshul/ skyes pa'i khyim dang ming gi brtsi tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ spyi'i nges pas 'byung chen brtsi tshul/ de las byung ba'i 'byung chung brtsi ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ phan tshun dgra dang grogs su 'gyur tshul/ yi ge gang la brtsi ba'i nges pa/ srog dang lus kyi dgra grogs bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gsungs pa/ a ku ha thaka mgrin byung gang / /dbyangs dang gsal byed mtshan nyid rnams/ /stong pa rlung sogs sngags rnams kyi/ /grogs po nyid kyi rtag tu gnas/ i tsu ya sha rkan byung rnams/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed mtshan nyid rnams/ /rlung gi khams las yang dag byung / /chu las skyes pa rnams kyi dgra/ /ṛ ṭu ra ṣa spyi bo skyes/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed mtshan nyid rnams/ /me yi khams las yang dag byung / /sa las skyes pa rnams kyi dgra/ /u pu wa kapa mchu skyes gang / /dbyangs dang gsal byed mtshan nyid rnams/ /chu yi khams las yang dag byung / /me las skyes pa rnams kyi dgra/ /l̥ tu la sa so skyes gang / /dbyangs dang gsal byed mtshan nyid rnams/ /sa yi khams las yang dag byung / /rlung las skyes pa rnams kyi dgra/ /rtag tu rlung gi grogs po me/ /tha mal pa chu nus med phyir/ /me yi grogs po rtag tu rlung / /sa ni btang snyoms nus med phyir/ /chu yi grogs po sa yin te/ /tha mal pa me nus med phyir/ /sa yi grogs po chu yin te/ /tha mal pa rlung nus med phyir/ /zhes te/ go bar zad do/ /zungs su gzung sla ba ni/ /chu me sa rlung g.yas skor gyis/

/gru bzhir bkod pa'i zur thad grogs/ /kun dang nam mkha' bzhi po yi/ /g.yas skor tha mal g.yon skor dgra/ /zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsungs pa/ oṃ gyi yi ge spangs nas ni/ /sngags kyi yi ge dang po rigs/ /de nyid sngags kyi thugs yin te/ /gzugs ni rdzogs pa'i rgyu yin no/ /gang tshe sngags kyi dang po yi/ /yi ge gsal byed gzhan brtsegs na/ /de dag las der dang po gzung / /dang por brjod pa'i rgyu yi phyir/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed dbye ba yis/ /de nyid rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur/ /zhes te/ thog ma'i oṃ gyi yi ge de nyid dgra grogs brtsi ba'i gzhir 'dzin pa spangs nas ni/ sngags kyi thog ma'i yi ge dang po de nyid gzhir gzung bar rigs shing / sngags kyi yi ge dang po de nyid sngags kyi thugs rdo rje yin te/ sku rdzogs pa'i rgyu'o/ /de bzhin du/ dus 'khor las/ ming gi dang po thugs rdo rjer 'gyur te mi yi bdag po lha dang lha mo rnams kyi'o/ /zhes pas/ lha'am sgrub pa po rang gi ming yig dang po de nyid dgra grogs brtsi ba'i gzhi dang / ming gi thugs rdo rje zhes bya'o/ /gang gi tshe sngags sam ming gi dang po'i yi ge dang gsal byed gzhan brtsegs pa hrīḥdang shrī lta bu yin na yang de dag las dang po ha dang sha lta bu brtsi ba'i gzhir gzung dgos te/ de dag dang por brjod par bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du brtsi ba'i gzhi la dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi dbye ba yod pas na/ brtsi tshul de nyid la yang dbyangs kyi dgra grogs dang / gsal byed kyi dgra grogs rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ gsungs pa/ srog gi dgra dang grogs po dang / /lus kyi yang ni brjod par bya/ /srog gi dgra dang grogs po'am/ /tha mal pa ni dbyangs rnams bshad/ /lus kyi dgra dang grogs po dang / /btang snyoms pa rnams gsal byed bshad/ /dbyangs kyi dgra yis sgrub pa po'i/

/srog 'phrog byed de the tsom med/ /lus kyi dgra bo gsal byed kyi/ /mtshan nyid can gyis nad sogs byed/ /ces te/ go bar zad la/ 'dir/ de ltar sngags dang rang ming gi /thog mar phan gnod shes byas nas/ /'khrug pa la yang dgra grogs kyis/ /rgyal 'pham 'dums pa sogs zhes bya/ /dbyangs yig dgrar gyur 'chi 'gyur zhing / /gsal byed dgrar gyur nad mang 'byung / /tha mal gyur na nyon mongs te/ /grogs por gyur na dngos grub ster/ /des na phan tshun grogs gyur pa'i/ /yi ge rnams kyi sngags bzlas bya/ /zhes kyang gzung ngo / /gnyis pa de las byung ba'i 'byung chung brtsi ba ni/ gsungs pa/ sde pa gcig la'ang ka la sogs/ /gsal byed chos can lnga rnams gang / /de rnams sa la sogs pa'i rigs/ /sngags sgrub pa la shes par bya/ /nga nya ṇa na ma 'di rnams/ /gzhan rnams grogs po nyid du gnas/ /gha dzha ḍha dha bha 'di rnams/ /chu las skyes pa rnams kyi dgra/ /ga dza ḍa da ba 'di rnams/ /sa las skyes pa rnams kyi dgra/ /kha tsha ṭha tha pha zhes 'di/ /me las skyes pa rnams kyi dgra/ /ka tsa ṭa ta pa zhes 'di/ /rlung las skyes pa rnams kyi dgra/ /de ltar phan tshun grogs po dang / /tha mal snga ma bzhin shes bya/ /zhes te/ ka sde sogs lnga po rang rang gi nang tshan gyi yi ge lnga la'ang / mas rim gyis/ nam mkha' rlung me chu sa'i khams kyi dbye ba yod pas/ de dag ni 'byung ba chung ba zhes rnam par gzhag nas/ de las brtags pa'i brtsi tshul yang 'di ltar/ nga nya sogs lnga pa lnga po 'di rnams ni nam mkha' ste gzhan gang dang yang phan tshun grogs po nyid du gnas la/ gha sogs bzhi pa rnams ni rlung ste chu skyes rnams kyi dgra'o/ /ga sogs gsum pa rnams ni me ste sa skyes rnams kyi'o/ /kha sogs gnyis pa ni chu ste me skyes rnams kyi'o/ /ka sogs dang po ni sa ste rlung skyes rnams kyi'o/ /de bzhin du/ zur thad phan tshun grogs po dang /

g.yon skor tha mal par gnas tshul sngar bzhin shes par bya'o/ /'dir gsal byed kyi 'byung chung brtsi ba la/ mthar gnas dang / dro ba dang / lce rtsa can dang / mchu can dang / rnam bcad dang / rjes su nga ro rnams kyi brtsi ba ma gsungs pa gang las shes par bya ba yin zhe na/ 'di la kha cig la sa gnyis dang po lnga bzhin sa khams dang / wa kapa gnyis gnyis pa lnga bzhin chu khams dang / ra ṣa gnyis gsum pa lnga bzhin me khams dang / ya sha gnyis bzhi pa lnga bzhin rlung khams dang / ha thaka gnyis pa lnga pa lnga bzhin nam mkha'i khams dang / rnam bcad ni ra'am sa yin pas me'am sa khams dang / rjes su nga ro ni nam mkha'i khams so zhes 'chad mod kyang / 'dir sde pa lnga min pa la 'byung chung bshad dgos pa gzhung gi dgongs pa la med pas/ rgyu med du ngal ba'i don med cing / mthar gnas bzhi ni rnam pa thams cad du 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i ngo bo nyid pas 'byung ba chung ba zhes bya ba'i brtsi gzhag dgos pa rig pa'i tshul ma yin pas shin du yang mi 'thad pa'o/ /gnyis pa skyes pa'i khyim dang ming gi brtsi tshul la gsum/ gnyis ga'i brtsi tshul mdor bstan/ gnyis kyi skyes khyim rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi don bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gsungs pa/ sngags kyi dang por yi ge gnas/ /rang gi sde pa'am gzhan rnams la'ang / /sgrub pa po yi yi ge gnyis/ /skye la skyes dang ming skyes 'gyur/ /de yang rnam gnyis yongs shes bya/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed mtshan nyid do/ /zhes te/ lha'i sngags kyi dang por yi ge gang gnas pa de'i rang gi sde pa'am gzhan la yang rung ste/ sgrub pa po'i yi ge dang po gnyis dang sbyar la brtsi bar bya'o/ /gnyis po gang na/ sgrub pa po skye ba'i dus kyi dus sbyor gyi chu tshod kyi rigs las skyes pa'i yi ge dang / ming las skyes pa'i yi ge'o/ /yi ge de dag la yang dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi dbye bas rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur ro/

/gnyis pa la gnyis/ khyim la 'char ba'i yi ge sbyong tshul/ phyi nang dus la 'char ba'i nges pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gsungs pa/ skyes bu'am bud med skye dus su/ /chu srin la sogs dus sbyor gang / /dbyu gu lnga yi bdag nyid gyur/ /de yis gsal byed sbyang bar bya/ /chu srin la ni ka sogs lnga/ /dbyu gu'i dbye bas sbyar bar bya/ /bum pa la yang nga sogs lnga/ /stong pa sogs rim dbye ba las/ /nya la'ang tsa la sogs rnams lnga/ /lug la'ang nya sogs rim pa bzhin/ /glang la'ang ṭa sogs lnga rnams so/ /'khrigs pa ṇa sogs de bzhin no/ /pa sogs karka ṭa sbyor la/ /ma sogs seng ge'i dus sbyor la'o/ /bu mo la na ིta sogs lnga/ /srang la de bzhin na sogs rnams/ /sdig pa la ni sa sogs lnga/ /gzhu la thaka la sogs rnams bshad/ /sdud dang spro ba'i sbyor bas so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 dgyes pa'i rdo rje/ dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i sngags kyi de kho na nyid la 'jug pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
